# ADR-067 — Checkpoint 9.8: Suggested Focus — a narrow, cited, bounded-candidate AI suggestion reusing 9.7's TodayContext and consent switch

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Checkpoint 9.8 — Suggested Focus: a narrow, cited, bounded-candidate AI suggestion over today's overdue/due-today tasks, built almost entirely from 9.7's own reuse surface (2026-09-15, owner-approved D1–D5 plus one product constraint).** **No migration; level stays 20; no new table, column, role, `ai_task_routes` row or consent surface; worker untouched.** Design-gate recommendation (Option E, a bounded combination) approved verbatim: **D1 — surface: E.** A mostly-deterministic strip (rendered for free from data the Today screen already fetches — no AI call, no consent gate) plus exactly ONE narrow, cited AI-generated line, never a full open narrative (Option A) and never a dedicated screen (Option D, explicitly rejected as redundant with the app's established behind-Settings minimalism for low-frequency surfaces). Options B ("what changed") and C (weekly review intelligence) are deferred, not built — both need genuinely new backend (a last-seen watermark; week-bucketed carry-forward diffing) the design gate found absent from the codebase. **D2 — generation: A+B.** The deterministic parts render on Today load; the one AI line fires only on an explicit tap, never on mount — proven by `today-suggested-focus.test.ts`, the same source-regex-guard convention `today-ask-chip.test.ts` established for 9.7. **D3 — storage: A, never**, matching Ask. **D4 — feedback: A, none**, with the "ready" render branch carrying a one-line extensibility comment rather than any built affordance. **D5 — proactivity: A, fully manual** — every model call is an explicit tap; no schedule, no push, no new notification channel (Lane 4 of the design gate found no existing Android channel maps to AI-generated planning content, and none was needed). **Owner-added product constraint, enforced structurally, not just in the prompt:** no model call below `FOCUS_MIN_CANDIDATES` (2) tasks in the `overdue`/`due_today` sections — the server computes the candidate ref set and refuses (`409 focus_not_enough_candidates`) BEFORE resolving any provider, so "avoid unnecessary AI calls" is a precondition the route enforces, not a request the model receives. **1. ZERO NEW INTELLIGENCE LINEAGE.** `POST /focus/suggestion` reuses `buildTodayContext(preset: "focus")` — the identical function and preset Ask's own "What should I focus on?" chip already uses — as its ONLY data source, and reuses the existing `ask` `ai_task_routes` row as its consent switch and model resolver (`resolveModelForTask(db, "ask", …)`), with the SAME `ASK_TODAY_CONSENT_FROM` vintage check. The Settings disclosure gains one appended sentence naming the new ACTION; no new data CATEGORY leaves the device, since the candidate set is a strict subset of what Ask's `<today>` block already discloses. **2. A NARROWER CITATION CONTRACT THAN ASK'S.** Where `validateCitations` lets Ask's answer cite zero or several refs, Suggested Focus requires **exactly one**, validated against the overdue/due-today ref set ONLY — never the full Today ref space, so a citation of an `upcoming` or `reminder` ref is exactly as invalid as one the model invented (`502 focus_uncited`). **3. THE GUARD-1/GUARD-4 PATTERN HOLDS FOR A SECOND LANE.** `apps/api/src/focus/generate.ts` lives outside `apps/api/src/intelligence/` — a sibling of `apps/api/src/ask/`, not a resident of the context-builder directory Guard 4 forbids `ai` imports and DB writes under — and becomes Guard 1's **sixth** pinned `generateText` call site, carrying the same `maxRetries: 0` / `experimental_telemetry: { isEnabled: false }` literals the other five do. This is the first time a second model-calling lane has been added since the pattern's five-site baseline; the mechanism held without modification. **4. ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (two lenses, API and mobile) found one MAJOR and fixed it before deployment.** The mobile `not_enough_candidates` render state was a dead end: `useMutation`'s `error`/`data` persist until a NEW `mutate()` call settles, and nothing offered a way back to one, so a real, everyday race — the owner completing one of exactly two overdue tasks between page load and the tap, or (independently) `today-context.ts`'s own pre-existing "LAST RESORT" drop-ladder pass touching even a *protected* section under a quote-heavy-title budget overflow — could strand the card permanently. Fixed with a "Check again" retry (cheap and safe: a re-refusal makes no model call). A second, MINOR finding — a rapid double-tap on the retry buttons could fire two `POST /focus/suggestion` requests before React's next render made `isPending` visible to the closure — is fixed with a `useRef`-based synchronous reentrancy guard in the Today screen (`focusRequestInFlightRef`), not local state in the reused component, because this app's hookless-component convention (established for `AskView`, restated in `cloud-ask-card.tsx`'s own module comment) means the card cannot own `useState` without breaking its no-renderer test harness. A route-comment claiming the "focus" preset unconditionally protects `overdue`/`due_today` from the drop ladder was corrected to name the pre-existing last-resort exception; the underlying security/correctness property — `candidateCount` is always computed from the exact same post-ladder object serialized into the prompt — was unaffected and needed no code change. **Deployed:** api + web rebuilt and recreated (worker untouched, no file in it changed); production acceptance walked the full contract live — 0 candidates → `409` (no model call) → 1 candidate → `409` → 2 candidates → `200` with a real, correctly-cited suggestion — then archived the smoke rows and disabled Cloud Ask again, restoring the shipped-OFF default. api 1382 tests (+49), mobile 1367 tests (+31), worker unchanged at 698. **Unchanged and reaffirmed:** ADR-018, ADR-024, ADR-056 (no embeddings, no pgvector, no write-capable lane), ADR-058, ADR-065, ADR-066 in full. **Recorded, not fixed:** the drop-ladder last-resort exception itself (pre-existing, inherited from 9.7's "focus" preset, not introduced here); the three-fold `isAbortLikeError` duplication is now four-fold (a fourth copy in `focus/generate.ts`, the established accepted pattern, not extracted); D1e remains deferred (Checkpoint 9.8, 2026-09-15)
